name: Kyocera Corporation
summary: Kyocera Corporation develops and sells products based on fine ceramic technologies in Japan, China, rest of Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through Core Components Business, Electronic Components Business, and Solutions Business segments.
